title: VoiceTelephonyProfileOvride - Tooling API
description: Represents profile-level telephony settings that override the default org-level configuration. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

ProfileId.description: Unique ID of the profile assignment to which the telephony configuration override applies. Each profile can have only one override assignment. This field is a relationship field.

VoiceTelephonyDefinitionId.description: ID of the voice telephony configuration associated with the override. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access this object, enable Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set.
